margin_definition.name: EBITDA margins (as reported)
margin_definition.source: management's reported margin for each quarter, on that quarter's results call (transcripts)

promises.target: investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30
promises.quote: in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.
promises.why: No annual capex figure reported; only half-year INR 6.1 bn disclosed.

promises.target: EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30
promises.quote: remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30
promises.why: EBITDA margins 13‑14% exceed the 8‑10% target range, so target not met.

promises.quote: Looking ahead, the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the high single digits over mid- to long term.
promises.why: Margins 13‑14% are above the 6‑9% high‑single‑digit target, meeting the at_least criterion.

promises.metric: Export contribution to overall top line
promises.target: greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030
promises.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
promises.why: Export contribution not reported; cannot assess against >10% target.

promises.quote: This represents a step forward towards our Project Spring goal of achieving a 30% payout ratio by financial year 2030.
promises.why: No reported dividend payout ratio data to assess target.

promises.target: INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years
promises.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years
promises.why: No cumulative capex data; only half-year INR 6.1bn reported.
